text:
alex_fin: Heads-up: VendorEdge charged us twice for the March reserved capacity settlement line on invoice VE-3301. Their CSV shows two identical entries (zone: us-west-2, instance_type: t4g.2x). Net duplicate is $2,400 after applying our partner discount. Need approval to issue goodwill refund and update our reconciliation.

jules_ops: Can you attach the vendor CSV excerpt so I can see the rows?

alex_fin: Pasted excerpt below (vendor masked ids):

```
vendor_invoice: VE-3301
2024-03-31,us-west-2,t4g.2x,capacity-reserved,1,2400,VE-3301-ROW-A
2024-03-31,us-west-2,t4g.2x,capacity-reserved,1,2400,VE-3301-ROW-A
```

riya_sales: Oof. Do we know whether VendorEdge self-corrects on their side? Might be they pushed duplicate rows. We should ask them to confirm and request a corrected invoice.

billing-bot: Duplicate vendor line heuristic: matched 2 rows, identical hash. Suggested action: create vendor dispute ticket and propose credit memo of $2,400.

alex_fin: I recommend we issue a temporary goodwill credit to the customer immediately (to avoid collection churn) and then recover from VendorEdge if they reimburse us. Approve?

ted_engineering: Quick note from infra: we saw a retry loop in our vendor ingestion lambda on 2024-03-31 02:12 UTC; Lambda invoked twice due to AWS event redelivery. We're adding dead-letter detection to prevent this class of duplicates.

jules_ops: Approve issuing the $2,400 goodwill credit to the customer pending VendorEdge confirmation. Please document recovery path.

riya_sales: I can own the partner comms post-credit. Will include note: "we issued a temporary credit and are working with VendorEdge for resolution."

billing-bot: Temporary credit memo draft CM-TEMP-VE-3301 created (amount: $2,400). Status: pending approval.

alex_fin: Approved. Please post the credit to the customer's account and mark reconciliation row as manual adjustment (reason: vendor double-bill).

jules_ops: Filed ticket VEND-2024-441 with VendorEdge, asked for corrected invoice or proof of reimbursement within 14 days.

ted_engineering: Deploying fix for lambda idempotency today; will follow up after canary.

riya_sales: Sending partner note now after finance posts credit. Will copy the support engineer.

alex_fin: Thanks all. I'll attach reconciled ledger entry to VEND-2024-441 once posted and then close the temporary credit if we get full reimbursement.

billing-bot: Action items: finance post credit, sales send comms, ops add recovery steps, eng deploy fix.

jules_ops: Looping in @procurement to keep VendorEdge accountable.

alex_fin: Marking this resolved for now. Will reopen if VendorEdge disputes.
